rights: Generated for this project from original written prompts; no third-party reference image or licensed asset was incorporated. Working names and sign copy are proposals, not clearance claims.
method: One independent built-in generation per setting with a shared palette/style brief and no input images. Original outputs remain in the tool output directory. Repository copies are resized to 1600 px wide and encoded as indexed PNG through ImageMagick with reduced error diffusion; no compositional edits.
encoding: magick SOURCE -resize 1600x -strip -define dither:diffusion-amount=50% -dither FloydSteinberg -colors 256 -define png:compression-level=9 PNG8:DESTINATION

images.name: Brackett
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Stage 1 whole-city setting reference for an original playful top-down 3D city sandbox.
Create one beautiful broad aerial establishing illustration, landscape 1792x1024 or wider, showing the city as a whole and its geographical setting, not one small neighbourhood. Smooth stylized 3D concept rendering with bevelled chunky masses, broad highlights, sparse surface detail, ordinary recognisable modern architecture, late-20th-century bones with present-day everyday life. Aerial three-quarter overview primarily reveals roofs; this is a setting illustration, NOT the actual gameplay camera. Show a believable coherent city with different neighbourhood characters suggested through massing, streets and roofs, without labels or prescribed district boundaries.
Shared Petrol & Coral palette: dark petrol #123646 roads, predominantly emerald #15564F roofs, restrained vivid coral #FF725D, cobalt #235FCC and amber #FFC05A accents, warm ivory #F6F1DC walls, slate #85929D sidewalks. Rich darker colours under fixed bright daytime sunlight and generous ambient fill, readable shadows. Ordinary architecture with only a few separated tall towers among broad areas of low-rise. Flat city streets, continuous connected street loops, sidewalks, calm street surfaces and small bright cars. Keep towers back from streets. Sparse simplified trees. Convey irreverent everyday urban character without dystopia.
Avoid futuristic cyberpunk architecture, night, sunset, dense neon, dense foliage, grime, photorealism, pixel art, tiny roof clutter, roads over roofs, elevated roads, bridges, ramps, on-road obstructions, explosions, HUD, UI, captions, lettering, logos and real-world landmarks. Water if present is at the edge, not a compulsory gameplay crossing. Do not draw an isolated six-block diorama.
Setting direction: A temperate elongated island city in a broad steel-blue estuary, with a strong disciplined rectangular street grid following the long island, varied low-rise brick commercial and residential blocks, broad warehouse piers at one end, a compact cluster of conventional office towers set well inside larger lots near the centre, open recreation grounds at the other end. Emphasise length, grid rhythm, economical land use and the ocean horizon; shoreline perimeter road returns around the island, no bridge. City still mostly low-rise, not a forest of towers. Crisp cool clear daytime. Busy, assertive, slightly self-important personality.

Pragmatic, cheeky, slightly pompous local institutions, not quaint fantasy Europe.

Setting direction: A landlocked planned city on a broad perfectly flat arid plateau, with distant rust-ochre mesas far beyond the built area and no water. Distinctive coarse fan-shaped radial avenues connected by several straight-sided polygonal ring streets, making a connected street web; NEVER giant multilane highway spaghetti. A bold low circular civic hall and wide paved public square anchors the middle, surrounded by low-rise shaded courtyard commerce, warehouse/service fringe, loose housing courts and a few separated slab towers. Broad roofs, sparse sculptural desert planting, compact walkable building clusters between clear street corridors. The city should have inhabited urban mass, not a tiny desert settlement. Dark emerald roofs and petrol asphalt temper ivory walls, amber desert and restrained coral/cobalt sunshades. Bright high daytime sun with strong ambient fill. Grandiose civic ambition, cheerful bureaucracy, a city absurdly proud of its master plan.
